caption:
7 in 10 online carts are abandoned. For shoppers ready to buy, the #1 reason is extra costs at checkout (Baymard).

Show the full price early and let people check out as a guest.

Want to know where your store leaks? DM "LEAK" for a free check.

#ecommerce #shopify #smallbusiness #onlinestore #businesstips
sources:
7 in 10: Baymard Institute, "Cart & Checkout Abandonment Rate Statistics", average of 50 studies = 70.22% (updated Sep 2025). https://baymard.com/lists/cart-abandonment-rate
#1 reason (excluding the 42% "just browsing"): extra costs too high (shipping, tax, fees) 40%. Same page.
"Nearly one in five" = "The site wanted me to create an account" 18% (4th reason). Same page, checked 2026-10-30.
